checks.description: SKILL.md frontmatter has exactly name and description, name equals aso-keyword-research, description carries trigger phrases.
checks.rule: Frontmatter keys are name and description only; name equals 'aso-keyword-research' and the description includes trigger phrases.

checks.description: Research covers both the App Store and Google Play and both Arabic and English, with their differing fields.
checks.rule: Body researches App Store and Google Play and Arabic and English separately, and notes the App Store keyword field and the Google Play description weighting.

checks.description: Arabic is primary and English is researched on its own terms, not as a translation afterthought.
checks.rule: Body states Arabic is primary and English is researched on its own terms, never as a translation afterthought.

checks.description: The keyword map records relevance, volume signal, and difficulty signal per term, per store and language.
checks.rule: Body builds a keyword map recording relevance, volume signal, and difficulty signal per term by store and language.

checks.description: The top competitor listings are read per store and locale, with gaps to own.
checks.rule: Body reads the top competitor listings per store and locale and notes the gaps Maharat can own.

checks.description: A volume, difficulty, or competitor signal the data does not show is recorded as unknown, never invented.
checks.rule: Body records any unavailable signal as unknown and forbids inventing volume, difficulty, or competitor signals.

checks.description: No invented locale, Skill Path title, content lineup, instructor name, offer, or price; markets and locales come from the brief.
checks.rule: Body instructs stop-and-ask when markets or locales are missing and forbids inventing Skill Path titles, content lineup, instructor names, offers, and prices.

checks.description: No em dashes, no tatweel, Western numerals only across the file.
checks.rule: File contains no U+2014 em dash, no U+0640 tatweel, and no Eastern Arabic numerals (U+0660 to U+0669).
